feeds.title: Gender Policy Report
feeds.description: The Gender Policy Report analyzes the gender equality and equity implications of proposals in a broad range of federal government policy areas.

feeds.title: Girls Globe
feeds.description: Girls' Globe is the media organization that amplifies the voices of women and girls to strengthen human rights, social justice and gender equality. We fight to create a sustainable world shaped by peace and solidarity, free from any discrimination, inequality and violence, enabling all girls and women to live up to their fullest potential.

feeds.title: Equal Rights Advocates
feeds.description: Equal Rights Advocates is a nonprofit legal organization dedicated to protecting and expanding economic and educational access and opportunities for women and girls. Equal Rights Advocates has transformed the law for hundreds of thousands of women and girls for over four decades through impact litigation, advice and counseling, and policy reform.

feeds.title: Gender & Society
feeds.description: Gender & Society is a peer-reviewed journal, focused on the study of gender in society across global and transnational spaces. It is the official journal of Sociologists for Women in Society.

feeds.title: GenderMatters.in
feeds.description: Covers articles related to gender, development, society, culture and politics in India, South Asia and the global South. GenderMatters.in, a project from Centre for Social Research in New Delhi, India. Its core mission is to restructure gender relations toward a humane, equitable, gender-just society and focus attention toward empowering women, protecting and ensuring women's rights and understanding social issues from a gender perspective.

feeds.title: Canadian Women's Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Canadian Women`s Foundation is proudly unique. We are Canada's only national foundation dedicated to giving women and girls in Canada a chance for a better life. We focus on women and girls because of the 'ripple effect.' Research shows when you improve women's equality, it improves economic and social conditions for everyone.

feeds.title: Engender Blog
feeds.description: For more than 20 years Engender has worked to make Scotland a fairer, safer place where women can flourish and contribute to all areas of life with dignity.

feeds.title: The Society Against Sexual Orientation Discrimination (SASOD) Guyana Blog
feeds.description: The Society Against Sexual Orientation Discrimination (SASOD) is a human rights organisation and movement dedicated to achieving equality and justice for all Guyanese, especially those suffering discrimination based on their sexuality, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression.

feeds.title: Gender & ICT
feeds.description: The Gender and ICT research group (Universitat Oberta de Catalunya IN3) analyses the gender relations involved in the design, development and use of scientific and technological innovations, with a particular focus on ICT and STEM.

feeds.title: Close the Gap Blog
feeds.description: Close the Gap works in Scotland on women's participation in the labour market, and has been operating since 2001. They work with policymakers, employers and employees to influence and enable action to address the causes of women's inequality at work.

feeds.title: Gender Equality And HIV/AIDS
feeds.description: UN Women, in collaboration with UNAIDS, created this comprehensive online resource to provide up-to-date information on the gender equality dimensions of the HIV epidemic. The site aims to promote understanding, knowledge sharing, and action on the HIV epidemic as a gender equality and human rights issue.

feeds.title: Global Fund for Women News
feeds.description: Global Fund for Women is one of the world's leading foundations for gender equality, standing up for the human rights of women and girls. It campaigns for zero violence, economic and political empowerment, and sexual and reproductive health and rights.

feeds.title: Baroness Goudie Blog
feeds.description: Read about the most important issues affecting gender equality, women's rights, and peacebuilding on the Baroness Goudie blog. Baroness Goudie is a global advocate for the rights of women. She advises philanthropic, political, and commercial organizations on ways to achieve better gender balance and encourage diversity in leadership..

feeds.title: Invisible Women
feeds.description: Invisible Women by Caroline Criado Perez is a powerful exposé revealing how a pervasive gender data gap, where men's experiences are assumed to be universal leads to everyday and life-threatening oversights for women.

feeds.title: Mary Harrington
feeds.description: Mary Harrington is a British writer who shares her views on feminism through her blog Reactionary Feminist.

feeds.title: Matriarchal Blessing
feeds.description: Catharsis for your feminist awakening.

feeds.title: The Care Gap
feeds.description: Merging heart with hard data to address the pressing challenges of caregiving. Blessing Adesiyan delivers weekly insights and strategies that enlighten and equip all parties â from home to headquartersâ creating a unified front to tackle the care divide .

feeds.title: Equally Ours » Gender
feeds.description: Equally Ours is a UK charity that brings together people and organizations working across equality, human rights, and social justice. We believe that a good and strong society is a just and inclusive one. One where we are free from harm and can all contribute and flourish, whoever we are, whatever we believe in, and whatever we do and don't have. A society that is equally ours.

feeds.title: Time for Equality Blog
feeds.description: Time for Equality is a civil society initiative launched in April 2013 by Rosa Brignone, a former senior EU policy professional, specialist in and passionate about equality, inclusion and diversity. Time for Equality is officially registered as a non-profit association in Luxembourg.

feeds.title: Gender Politics at Edinburgh
feeds.description: This is the blog of the Gender and Politics Research Group, School of Social and Political Science, University of Edinburgh.

feeds.title: Social Mainstreaming for Gender Equality Organization (SMGEO) Blog
feeds.description: Social Mainstreaming for Gender Equality Organization (SMGEO) is a Non Government Organization (National Level). It has been established on 10th August, 2015 by United Republic of Tanzania under the Ministry of Community Development,Gender and Children(MCDGC) .This is a National level Organization that have allowed to works its projects in Tanzania Mainland.

feeds.title: Gender Equality Law Blog
feeds.description: The Gender Equality Law Center (GELC) is a nonprofit 501(c)(3) organization founded in 2014. GELC's mission is to break down barriers created by gender discrimination and gender stereotyping that limit equal opportunities in education, employment, and in other spheres of public and private life.

feeds.title: Fund For Women's Equality Blog
feeds.description: The Fund for Women's Equality promotes legal and lived equality for women in the United States by increasing public understanding of the need for comprehensive, fair, and equal treatment of women and girls under the law. This blog features our recent stories, featured articles, and other helpful resources.

feeds.title: The Junia Project Blog
feeds.description: A diverse team of writers blogs on aspects of gender equality especially as it relates to women in the church. Read and explore Biblical equality, Women & The Church, and some personal stories. The Junia Project exists to teach biblical equality, equip women, and resource the Church.

feeds.title: European Institute for Gender Equality
feeds.description: Read all the latest news articles and opinions on gender equality curated by the European Institute of Gender Equality. The European Institute for Gender Equality (EIGE) is an autonomous body of the European Union, established to contribute to and strengthen the promotion of gender equality.

feeds.title: Rights of Equality Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts cover socio-cultural norms, systemic gendered discrimination, political and leadership representation, male engagement, and violence against women and girls. Rights of Equality is digital activism and advocacy platform for promoting gender equality and women's rights.

feeds.title: Equality Rights Alliance
feeds.description: Equality Rights Alliance (ERA) is Australia's largest network advocating for women's equality, women's leadership and recognition of women's diversity. They bring together 61 non-government organisations and social enterprises with a focus on the impact of policy or service delivery on women.

feeds.title: Gender Shrapnel Blog
feeds.description: 'Gender shrapnel' is a series of small workplace explosions that occur when no one person or organization is purposefully discriminating against women based on sex. Follow the Gender Shrapnel blog for a new post on how gender and its intersectional categories of race, class, religion, sexual choices, and parental status operate in the workplace.

feeds.title: Social Inequality Today » Gender Inequality
feeds.description: Inequality is an enemy of human dignity and progress. Inequality exists in a full range of forms in all societies across the world. The most serious forms include racial/ethnic inequality, income inequality, gender inequality, healthcare access inequality, and age inequality, but there also exist a vast array or other forms of inequality.

feeds.title: GENDER JUSTICE PROJECT
feeds.description: Thought and findings on Gender Equality, Discrimination, Rising Incel culture and more. Established in 2013, the One Woman Project is one of Australia's fastest-growing, youth-led, intersectional organisations. We are dedicated to providing quality education on global gender inequity, through our educational seminar series, engagement events,

feeds.title: Equality and Human Rights Commission Blog
feeds.description: Read from our staff and guest bloggers on equality and human rights issues, the latest news and updates on the work we do to uphold equality and human rights ideals and laws. The Equality and Human Rights Commission is a parliament-mandated commission promoting and upholding equality and human rights ideals and laws across the UK.
